acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every record in a baseline carries the same baseline id and a monotonic revision history
acceptance_criteria.evidence_of_conformance: All records validate. The 2026-09-29 baseline adds 41 records at revision 1 with a populated history.
acceptance_criteria.how_conformance_is_checked: Validate every record against artifact-base.schema.json, which requires baseline_id and revision_history, and confirm no revision number is reused with different content.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every link records the revision of both endpoints
acceptance_criteria.evidence_of_conformance: The link schema requires both. A link whose endpoint is revised without the link being revisited is the failure this criterion cannot catch, and the corpus records that limitation explicitly rather than claiming the criterion covers it.
acceptance_criteria.how_conformance_is_checked: Confirm no link omits source_revision or target_revision.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A communication of an agreed revision carries an acknowledgement
acceptance_criteria.evidence_of_conformance: One communication in this project has no acknowledgement. Recorded as improvement FB2-PIM-IMP-000002, whose verdict is insufficient_evidence because no acknowledgement record exists and none can.
acceptance_criteria.how_conformance_is_checked: Confirm each performed communication carries an acknowledgement record reference, or an explicit statement that none was captured.

accountable_role.independence: The configuration control board may not baseline a record whose author is a board member. In this corpus the board is the traceability engineer and the authors are domain roles, so the separation holds structurally; what does not hold is any human oversight of the board's decisions.

record_verbatim.definition: Configuration management is the identification, baselining, change control and status accounting of the corpus's records. Every record carries a profile, a baseline id, a revision and a revision history, and every link carries the revisions of both endpoints. A change to a baselined item goes through the change-control process and not through this one; this process identifies and baselines, that one decides.
